content: Extensible editor cores split into a host-agnostic core plus adapters. Cockburn ports-and-adapters: the core defines interfaces (ports) and never imports adapter code; adapters implement them and are injected. For extracting a core from a monolith, Fowler Branch by Abstraction is the in-process counterpart of Strangler Fig: create the abstraction, move callers behind it, build the new implementation, switch incrementally, then delete the temporary abstraction. Anti-corruption layers are required when old code must call the new core. Common failure modes are wrong decomposition and the facade becoming its own monolith.
